newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Nizhny Novgorod to issue Eurobond in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Russian Nizhny Novgorod to issue Eurobond in Sept.

text.p: Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region plans to issue its debut Eurobond in September, a local administration official said on Thursday.
"The governor said the Eurobond issue is planned for September," the head of the Securities Department, Yuri Podlesov, told Reuters.
Nizhny plans to issue up to $100 million in five-year paper via ING Barings.
President Boris Yeltsin in spring authorised the City of Moscow, St Petersburg and Nizhny Novgorod to issue Eurobonds.
Moscow and St Petersburg have already issued Eurobonds, but Nizhny's issue was delayed by gubernatorial elections after its former governor Boris Nemtsov became First Deputy Prime Minister.
Podlesov said the region expected to get a licence for the issue from the central bank in the next few days. After this, the issue must be registered with the Finance Ministry.
Podlesov said the road-show dates were not set yet.
